description: Video to transcript: transcribe the speech in a video file at a URL (MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV with an audio track; max 20 MB) with Whisper large v3 turbo. Returns full text, language, duration, timestamped segments and WebVTT captions ready for subtitles. task=translate gives English text. Price $0.03 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"text":"Hello and welcome to the show.","language":"en","duration_seconds":4.2,"task":"transcribe","format":"mp4","bytes":67000,"word_count":6,"segments":[{"start":0,"end":4.2,"text":"Hello and welcome to the show."}],"model":"whisper-large-v3-turbo"}

url.description: Public URL of the media file itself

vad.description: true to apply voice activity filtering

name: video_transcribe
